text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Walking through the academy while thinking 
about the individuality of Umamusume makes 
me realize once again just how diverse 
they all are.
choice_data_list: (For example—)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm gonna do my best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara—full of energy and all pumped 
up, she is about to take on a mock race.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Urara-chan! Go take first place!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is cheered on by many Umamusume... and 
the reason isn't just her innocent nature.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho! Heave-ho! Heave-ho! Heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Gentle Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Urara-senpa~i! You're doing great, keep it 
up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara runs with all her might, but... 
she falls further and further behind the 
lead. Truth be told, she lacks the 
standout talent of the others. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Phewww...! Hup! Hup! Hup!!!!
choice_data_list: Hang in there...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara lost the race. Yet, warm 
applause rained down on her for running 
her hardest to the very end without ever 
giving up.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I lost again! But I'll take 1st place 
next time!"
choice_data_list:
(Seeing her work so hard gives me 
courage—)

text_block_list.name: Gentle Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Urara-senpai is so amazing. Yeah, 
I'm gonna give it my all too, ya hear!
choice_data_list: Are you a fan of Urara?
Are you a fan of Urara?

text_block_list.name: Gentle Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm originally from Kyushu, you 
see... and Urara-senpai is from around 
there too, right? So I feel a certain 
kinship with her.

text_block_list.name: Gentle Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Just like you, Senpai, I want to keep 
smiling and doing my best even when I 
lose... and bring big glory back to my 
hometown."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheerful as she was, she too seemed to 
possess a distinct individuality. Every 
single Umamusume has something uniquely 
her own.
choice_data_list:
(The one who knows that individuality best 
is...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right then, inspiration struck! If I 
listen to what fans have to say about the 
girl they support— their "fave"—it might 
make for good reference.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, when I consulted with Chairwoman 
Akikawa...”

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Approved! Let us open Tracen Academy's 
gates for "Fan Appreciation Day"!
choice_data_list: So, I have a favor to ask...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to share the Umamusumes' unique 
charm not just with the fans at the venue, 
but with as many people as possible. So—
choice_data_list:
May I post an introductory video on social 
media?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Of course! —Approved!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as part of "Fan Appreciation Day," 
fans were specially permitted to observe 
the Umamusume's training sessions.
choice_data_list:
(Alright, let's hear all kinds of 
stories—)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Noooo waaayyyy!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I won't do it! I won't ruuuuun!!

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
No, but still... We need to show the fans 
the brilliance of your sharp acceleration—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Like I said, there's no point in showing 
me now! If you're gonna do it, do it on 
the track! I mean—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The magic of a "serious race" is the 
greatest of all! I'm not gonna run here!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a coincidence, Sweep. I was free, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Another problem child added to the 
list...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep Tosho, Gold Ship. Both are 
Umamusume whose charm far exceeds the 
simple label of 'eccentric.'"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if you're not doing anything 
anyway... How 'bout we unleash something 
fiery?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ! Hey, does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Mountain pantomime!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: In a race, right!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's that?! Let's do it, Mountain 
Pantomime!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm…… NOT doing thaaaat!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yamiiiiiiime!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAHH!!
choice_data_list: (What overwhelming presence...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The chase that started out of nowhere 
between the two of them eventually turned 
into a dead-serious contest. And thenâ

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaahhh!!!!
choice_data_list: (Hm? From the side too...?)

text_block_list.name: Office Worker A
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-chan... is so cool... She's so cute, 
yet stays true to herself... Not caring 
what anyone thinks.

text_block_list.name: Office Worker A
text_block_list.text:
And when she runs, her late-race burst is 
so sharp...! ...I want to live strong like 
that, too.

text_block_list.name: Office Worker B
text_block_list.text: Ghh~~, Golshi...! What reckless abandon!

text_block_list.name: Office Worker B
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's not like he's just acting 
recklessly... Well, actually he is, but he 
doesn't hurt anyone. ...Man, I wish I had 
confidence like that too.

text_block_list.name: Office Worker A
text_block_list.text: !! U-Um! I-I feel the same way!

text_block_list.name: Office Worker A
text_block_list.text:
I look up to Sweepy-chan and wish I could 
speak my mind clearly like her, too. My 
fave is just so cool, isn't she...!

text_block_list.name: Office Worker B
text_block_list.text:
I completely understand!!!! ...Would you 
mind chatting about it a bit more with 
me?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
“—Jeez...! Golshi, you are so 
persistent...!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then—an elegant Umamusume in a black 
hood and a strikingly beautiful Umamusume 
with pure white hair walked by 
side-by-side.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You! The black one over there! Take my 
place and—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait, why a lion dance!? Hey, where are 
you goingーー!?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Haha, what a bunch of tomboys! ...Wait, 
what's up with you? Staring off into space 
like that.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That white girl... she's so cute...! Way 
too beautiful...! I want to cheer for her!
choice_data_list:
(Love at first sight really does happen, 
huh.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While keeping the camera rolling, we moved 
over to the paddock practice stage, which 
was also packed with bustling fans.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Look, here it comes...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Rejoice, commoners.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I am the King.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaah! Lady Orfevre~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Radiating an overwhelming presence, the 
one who appeared was—Orfevre. Highly 
eccentric, with sheer ability that was 
undeniably top-tier.
choice_data_list:
(That's right, I should hear directly from 
the fans too...)

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"First off, just look at Orfe-san's 
presence! She seems to shine in gold... So 
cool~~!"

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Besides... above all, the sheer presence 
when she runs! She's insanely powerful, 
yet a bit tyrannical... That truly kingly 
aura is just the best... ♡
choice_data_list: I see...

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Trainer! Take a picture of that girl 
who just came out too! She's my second 
favorite~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Urged to look, I see an Umamusume 
emerge... Her head is lowered, eyes cast 
downward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She looks a bit downcast, or perhaps 
unmotivated, but...
choice_data_list: Is she going to be all right...?

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's actually her at "peak 
condition"! Because she's—

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
When I look down, that's when I'm 
strongest! Please, come watch the race!

text_block_list.name: Unmotivated? Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAHH!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as the fans had predicted, she carved 
out a fierce victory in the mock race that 
followed――

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fan
text_block_list.text:
There are just so many unique 
Umamusume...! My list of favorites just 
keeps on growing. Honestly—it's so much 
fun!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Basking in the passion of the fans after 
that... I was able to capture plenty of 
footage of the unique, charming Umamusume.
choice_data_list: (Gotta give this editing my all!)
(Gotta do my best with the editing!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to publish this before "Dream Fest" 
begins to build up the hype. As I struggle 
to edit the video for social media—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: —Oh, what a wonderful video!
choice_data_list: Ms. Haiseiko!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Who took this picture? Could it be... you, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list:
I wanted to share the charm of Umamusume 
with as many people as possible!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, your feelings will definitely get 
through! Because it really is wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's individuality is sparkling and 
standing out... It's so charming!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: —Ah, right!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Actually, about the upcoming all-star 
race... the 'Dream Fest'—we're all 
brainstorming promotional themes for it.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: "I just had an idea! —How about 'Stella'?"
choice_data_list: You mean "star" in Italian...?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Yes! So that every Umamusume can shine as 
her true self!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"And so that those who support me can 
enjoy that brilliance..."

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: <nickname>-chan is running as well, right?
choice_data_list: Yes, that's the plan!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure she'll deliver a wonderful run 
that captures everyone's hearts!"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
A contest of Stellas transcending 
generations! ――I can't wait♪
